name: second-bounce
about: Review bounces the PR twice: after the second, loopd sends the item to the user (needs-you, with the review's notes), and the bot @mentions the approver in the thread. Both reviews are on the PR as comments.

question.a: ^`feature\.txt:1`: add a test for the empty case\.$
